items.title: You've bought an asset manager. How do you get their people to stick around?
items.summary: Last week, the CEO of Apollo Global Management, Marc Rowan, spoke of the “brain damage” that comes from buying other asset managers. At the heart of this is a thorny question: How do you get rainmakers to stick around once their firm is folded into a larger corporate structure? Economics is a key consideration.
